patch_description: The previous SEARCH pattern didn't match the file, so I anchor on the dispatcher's return statements, which are known verbatim. Instead of modifying the unknown internals of the enhanced filter, I add a vectorized post-processing pass `_post_process` that wraps both filter paths. It computes a locally adaptive robust noise scale: rolling ±25-sample MAD of the diffs of the filtered output (via sliding_window_view over edge-padded diffs), scaled 0.6× per sample. Where the raw signal deviates from the filtered output by more than the local threshold, the filtered sample snaps to the raw value. Noisy non-stationary segments (low local σ) get aggressive snapping to reduce lag error, while clean/strongly trending segments (high local σ) keep their smooth dynamics, preventing new spurious reversals. This directly targets the lag_error objective without degrading the reversal or tracking scores.
